newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund post outflows in 2-day period-survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund post outflows in 2-day period-survey.

text.p: U.S. stock funds recorded outflows of $130 million for the two-day period ended February 24 compared with inflows of $561 million for the three-day period ended February 20, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracker said aggressive growth funds recorded outflows of $303 million versus outflows of $134 million, while growth and income funds inflows fell to $218 million from $466 million, and international funds dropped to $14 million from $103 million.

Bond funds posted outflows of $244 million versus infows of $46 million. Outflows of corporate/income/global funds rose to $154 million from $47 million. Muni funds recorded outflows of $218 million versus $90 million.
